summary: No high findings. Fixed: migration no longer moves the .code-workspace (relative '..' would break), refuses symlinked legacy/pastes dirs, uses COPYFILE_EXCL and treats copy/verify failures as conflicts, route clears the actions cache in finally; reset clears the cache in finally; actions stub no longer shadows a legacy actions.json; workspace write is best-effort after create(); cwd attribution picks the longest matching project root.

review.finding: Migrating the .code-workspace file breaks its relative '..' folder.
Symlinked pastes/.shipwright-webui dir lets migration delete files outside the repo.
copyFileSync without COPYFILE_EXCL can overwrite / write through a dangling symlink; mid-loop throw escapes uncaught.
Actions cache stale after a partial reset failure.
Empty central stub shadows a legacy in-repo actions.json.
Project persisted before workspace file write; a throw yields 500 and a duplicate on retry.
centralRootForTask picks the first matching project, not the longest.
